diagram_math_checks.result: Each picture has exactly three wires, ordered a,b,t from top to bottom, representing Q_3=(C^2)^{tensor 3}. B and the embedded T_t both map Q_3 to itself. The B boxes span all three wires; T occupies only the bottom wire. This agrees with Definition lines 34–46 and the local syntax/denotational definitions.

Reading the rendered expansion left to right gives H_t; CNOT_b,t; T_t^dagger; CNOT_a,t; T_t; CNOT_b,t; T_t^dagger; CNOT_a,t; T_b; T_t; H_t; CNOT_a,b; T_a; T_b^dagger; CNOT_a,b. These are the exact 15 gates of steps 1–4. All six CNOTs have a filled control and open circled-plus target at the stated ordered wires. Crossing the middle wire at CNOT_a,t does not add a control: no dot is placed there.

Overview left B is steps 1–4, middle T_t is step 5, right B is step 6 and uses the same full expansion. The chronological picture therefore denotes matrix B T_t B with later actions on the left, as in the local denotational semantics. No fourth wire or additional gate is implied.

Read the local correctness proposition, especially steps 1.1–3.1, and the exact local H,T,T-dagger,CNOT matrices and ancilla definition. Independently applied all 15 gates to all eight ordered basis vectors: B sends |a,b,t> to |a,b,t xor ab> with max complex-amplitude error 3.1401849173675503e-16. Applying B,T_t,B to the four clean inputs returns 000,010,100,110 respectively with omega-exponents 0,0,0,1 and max error 4.440892098500626e-16. Thus the overview return-zero label is justified for the complete circuit; neither B alone is labeled as restoring zero. This is C(T)=diag(1,1,1,omega) on data in control-first order.

No statement, hypothesis, gate list, dependency, source, or proof was changed. The existing separate proposition establishes the basis action and reference-register extension without using either figure. Pictures illustrate its already stated action and are outside all proof-like sections.
